name: Ring of Truth (Legendary Games)
body:
Price 30,000 gp; Slot ring; CL 7th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate divination

DESCRIPTION

This ring of pure silver is usually unadorned or else set with small white stones. You gain a +10 competence bonus on Sense Motive and Diplomacy checks to gather information, Linguistics checks to spot forgeries, and Perception checks made to oppose Sleight of Hand and Disguise checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 15,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells discern lies
